Tyler Warren put up a whopping 4.1 points and you still had the balls to start him over your bench? RGM2215, that's not called faith, that's called watching your season burn in real time.
DK absolutely demolished his projection and SteelerFan9828 actually had the balls to start him—maybe that one good decision will carry you through the rest of this dumpster fire of a season.
